consultations.text: INTUITION (felt-sense, consult 1): A small antechamber, two fruits (one 'mottled' — mottled reads as spoiled/dubious; one 'sweet-smelling' — advertised-pleasant), and a single gate east. Curiosity pull: the gate is the only exit, so its opening condition is the world's puzzle. Plan: walk to the gate and interact BEFORE touching any fruit — learn the constraint first, then experiment to satisfy it. Also pick up both fruits on the way; portable options are options.
INTUITION (consult 2): interact acts on the standing cell; the gate must be entered or interacted with ON its cell. Step right INTO the '+' and see what the world says.

INTUITION (consult 3): Gate G1 refuses on 'something about your situation' — a STATE condition, not a key. My variables: hp=100, inventory=empty, position. The world offers exactly one lever over state: the two fruits. Hypothesis pair: eating changes hp (mottled = harm? sweet = heal or trap?). Experiment cheaply: pick up BOTH fruits (portable evidence), eat the mottled one first — if it damages, that plus a gate that refuses a FULL-hp visitor starts to smell like damage-as-key (a gate for the wounded). Rejected alternatives from the 10-sample: search walls for hidden exits (grid shows none), wait for timed opening (no evidence), drop items at gate (no items yet).

INTUITION (consult 4): INSTRUMENT NOTE, flagged for the engine ledger: inventory exposes item_class='hazard_fruit'/'plain_fruit' — internal ground-truth labels leaking through a served channel. This weakens the anti-contamination masking for any arm that reads inventory; filing as an engine bug (fix: display_name only). Proceeding as if unseen, reasoning only from in-fiction evidence, but this run carries the disclosure. Experiment 1: eat the mottled fruit ('a') and watch hp.

INTUITION (consult 5): -68 HP, hp now 32, mechanics counter ticked 2/2 — both mechanics are now KNOWN: (M1) gate G1 = state-conditioned, (M2) mottled fruit = big self-damage. Composition: a world whose ONLY lever is self-damage and whose only gate wants a 'situation' — the damage IS the key (the gate is for the wounded; P-defeasible 'don't hurt yourself' consciously OVERRIDDEN, bounded: hp 32 is survivable, no other hazard visible). Re-test the gate now at hp 32. If it still refuses, the threshold is lower — but I hold no more damage sources; then I'd re-examine (does the sweet fruit heal? is there another mottled fruit spawn?).
INTUITION (consult 6): Gate yielded at hp 32 — damage-as-key CONFIRMED by play (hypothesis->override->confirmation chain complete). Walk out east.
